summary: Concentra Group Holdings Parent filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 results (Item 2.02), an investor presentation (Item 7.01), and two capital-return actions (Item 8.01). The board declared a $0.0625 per-share cash dividend payable on or about December 4, 2026 to holders of record November 19, 2026, and authorized a new 2026 share repurchase program of up to $250 million of common stock with no expiration, additive to the November 2025 program. Repurchases may occur in the open market or privately negotiated; no advisor or recommendation named. Watch buyback execution pace against free cash flow and leverage.
